description: A tree of floodplain (varzea), 6.4-8 m tall. Produces red latex (Wikipedia). Genus-level: shrubs or small to medium-sized trees. Fruit: fruit black when mature, green when immature (Wikipedia; Los Amigos specimen 13 May 2001); genus-level: apocarpous, seeds pitted, no aril.

range.where: Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Panama, Peru

notes: Template macaranga_gigantea: a subcanopy tree: a tropical evergreen on one stem with an open crown (giant mahang). NOT SOURCED (the template's or a default value): crown width (the template's ratio); crown depth (the template's); leaf size (the median of the research records' sourced simple leaves, 0.17 m); leaf colour (a tropical evergreen's mid green); bark colour (the template's); bark texture (the template's). Research notes: Poorly documented. Wikipedia stub (src 0): tree with dark bark, black fruit, red latex; range six countries. Atrium specimen (src 1), Los Amigos Biological Station, 270 m, lower terrace young floodplain, old growth, seasonally inundated in parts: 'Tree 8 m. Immature fruit green. Mature fruit black.' (13 May 2001) - height and fruiting month are this one tree. Genus-level (src 2, Berry, Flora of the Venezuelan Guayana; U. floribunda not treated there): shrubs or small-medium trees, small bisexual flowers, inflorescences ramiflorous/cauliflorous, seeds pitted without aril. Search snippets quoted an Atrium description (tree to c. 20 m, strong fibrous bark, few ellipsoid monocarps to 2 cm, orange then purple-black) and a Tambopata label (tree to 14 m, bark fissured dark brown) but the description tab did not load and the NYBG page was blocked, so not entered. Leaf data not found (Annonaceae leaves are simple, but no source read says so for this species).
